svg.text: LLMs as recognizers on the CLARA grid benchmarks: P(true goal)
Mean over evidence files; each LLM answered every file 3 times.
Stems run from chance to the score, so a dot left of the dashed line is below chance.
the real test: no candidate goal is reached yet
the stop rule alone scores 1.0: each plan ends when its goal holds
CLARA has no max-term records for ThreePackage or FourPackage. SharpSAT-TD and MC-SAT solved only some small grids, so they are left out here
and compared with each LLM on shared files in results/clara/report.md, which also gives 95% intervals.
